entries.text: The first creatures, 173 Lameza, landed on the empty shore.
Newcomers landed: 14 Nemafa came ashore from elsewhere.
Among the Lameza was born the island's first giant.
The first amphibious creature appeared among the Lameza.
Among the Lameza was born the island's first creature that sleeps through the cold.
Among the Lameza was born the island's first venomous creature.
The first poisonous plants took root on the island.
Among the Lameza, a group grew apart: the Lameme.
Among the Lameme was born the island's first creature that feeds on sunlight.
The Nemafa took to the water: the island's first swimmers.
Hard times for the Lameza: only 58 are left of 173.
The Nemafa are thriving: from 14 to 51 in 30 days.
A new species, the Lamere, branched off the Lameme.
Among the Lameza, a group grew apart: the Lamehe.
The first giant trees above the canopy took root on the island.
The first fruit trees took root on the island.
Autumn came. 191 creatures of 5 species live on the island.
Among the Lamehe, a group grew apart: the Lamepu.
